d: Omar Kassem Alesayi Group is looking for a sharp, organized and discreet Legal Affairs Specialist. You’ll manage the principal’s personal legal portfolio and run legal and administrative support for the office.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Law or Sharia (Systems)
5–7 years’ experience at a law firm or in-house legal department, including hands-on case follow-up
Strong knowledge of Saudi laws: Companies, Civil Transactions, Litigation, Enforcement and Labor
Experience in legal secretarial work: correspondence, archiving, scheduling and formal letters
Fluent Arabic and English, advanced MS Office, and familiarity with the Najiz platform
r: Set up and maintain one central register of all legal matters: cases, contracts, claims and obligations
Follow up with external law firms and subsidiary legal departments on case status and deadlines
Flag upcoming deadlines that need a decision, signature or attendance
Review legal files and prepare first-stage legal opinions covering position, risks, options and recommendation
Review contracts and legal memos before they are submitted
Prepare regular status reports on open legal matters
Manage legal correspondence, archiving, powers of attorney and license renewals
Track regulatory changes in KSA and flag anything that affects active matters
